intent: Accept externally delivered callback tokens only after cryptographic verification, exact workflow-node-event-action binding and atomic replay admission.
invariants: A token cannot authorize a different execution, node, event or action than the target encoded in its signed claims.
Invalid signature, invalid time window, unknown key or binding mismatch cannot consume replay admission for a valid token.
For concurrent delivery of one valid token, exactly one caller may pass replay admission.
Stage-17 ingress rejects legacy callback tokens that do not carry an explicit action binding.
Key-rotation overlap remains valid for reviewed configured keys while retired keys fail closed.
acceptance_evidence: Tampered and mismatched attempts do not burn a subsequently valid callback.
32-way concurrent duplicate delivery yields exactly one accepted callback and 31 replay rejections.
Critical changed-code mutation testing has no LIVED, NOT COVERED or TIMED OUT blocker.
Repository CI and race gates remain green.
